title: Describe the units changed
responsibility: Names distinct registered owners of changed files and counts files without owners.

inputs.name: changedUnits.paths
inputs.description: The changed file paths to look up. Paths are not included in the returned notice; repeated input paths can still increase the unowned-file count.

inputs.name: changedUnits.owners
inputs.description: A lookup returning owning unit identities for each path. Only identities matching the unit-reference grammar are included; an empty result counts the path as unowned.

outputs.name: changedUnits
outputs.description: A notice with distinct valid unit identities sorted and written as unit references, limited to 40 named units with any remainder counted. Also counts paths with no owners. Returns an empty string when neither valid owners nor unowned paths can be reported.
